limitations: One AI reviewer per case; no independent repeated annotation or inter-rater reliability
Image-visible objects and COCO crowd/area>=2% category rules differ
AI no or uncertain against annotation-positive is not proof of annotation error
AI yes against annotation-negative may reflect tiny objects, depiction, missing annotation, or AI error; requires human adjudication
Strata overlap and diagnostic sampling prevent a pooled population mislabel estimate

limits: Historical numerical reproduction failed and stays MISMATCH
Best COCO M1 was selected among 98 settings; nominal selected CI is not post-selection-valid
OOF intervals condition on fixed trained selectors and do not undo prior panel exposure
Fixed native MCMR subset/adapters differ from the full official benchmark; no external retuning
One AI reviewer per image is not adjudicated human gold
Human-reviewed independent data, any training, and formal cluster confirmation are future work
